text:
alex: Heads-up — we're hitting GPU and networking limits in the new eu-west4 project while trying to bring up the private-prod cluster. Need quota increases for A100 80GB and additional internal IPs. Can someone pick this up?

mira: on it. Which project id and exact quotas? Also do we want ND96 or A2 as fallbacks?

alex: project: redwood-inference-priv-prod-eu. Need: 8 x A100 80GB (a2-highgpu-1-g?), actually GCP SKU shows as a100-80gb-v2-count (we requested 8 GPUs), and +250 internal IP addresses for node pools (secondary IPs).

samir: pasting the scheduler error we saw when provisioning the node pool: 
```
Warning: Insufficient resource 'GPUS' available in zone europe-west4-a. Requested: 8 x A100_80GB
Error: could not allocate secondary IPs: quotaExceeded for reservedPeeringIps
```

leah: cost note — A100 80GB w/ sustained use will be ~5x our A2 fallback. If we can land A2 or T4 temporarily, app will be fine for non-prod traffic. But prod needs A100 for throughput.

mira: opened a case with GCP Cloud Support, they gave a case number and ETA. Case created for both GPU quota and VPC secondary IP quota. I'll paste the case auto-reply.

infra-bot: New support case created: CASE-2026-80432. Assigned to GCP Support team.

mira: auto-reply excerpt: "Case CASE-2026-80432: We are investigating availability for A100_80GB in europe-west4 and checking reserved internal IP quota for project redwood-inference-priv-prod-eu. Expected update in 48-72 hours unless escalated."

alex: can someone escalate? We're blocked on a customer private deployment starting Monday. If GCP leadtime is 72h, that's tight. @mira can you request Priority escalation citing customer SLA?

mira: yes. I've requested priority escalation and also asked that they check adjacent zones (europe-west4-b/c) and if not available, suggest compatible SKU fallbacks (A100_v1 or ND96). Also asked about applying a regional quota increase vs per-zone.

samir: FYI the cluster autoscaler will schedule into any zone that has GPUs in the same region, but nodepool networking (secondary IP range) is per-subnetwork; we need the increase at project/subnet level. I attached the command I used to repro the secondary IP error: 
```
gcloud container node-pools create gpu-pool --cluster=priv-prod --zone=europe-west4-a --machine-type=a2-highgpu-1 --num-nodes=2 --accelerator type=nvidia-tesla-a100,count=4 --enable-ip-alias
```

leah: also pinged finance about potential short-term reservation for Dedicated capacity vs on-demand burst to guarantee capacity if GCP can't commit quickly. They said ops should provide estimated hours and instance types.

alex: estimate: first week ramp needs 8 A100_80GB for 24/7, roughly ~1344 GPU-hours. Add margin for canary capacity. I'll put a quick cost calc in the ticket.

mira: update from GCP via email (forwarded): "Assigning to quota team. We can provision additional A100 capacity regionally but need org quota approval and justification. Preliminary ETA: 36 hours. Secondary IP quota increase approved for +300 IPs. Case ref: CASE-2026-80432. To expedite, please provide expected steady-state GPU hours and linked billing account."

alex: sweet — secondary IPs approved helps the nodepool. Mira, can you post the billing account string and the steady-state numbers (8 GPUs 24/7) in the case thread so they can approve regionally?

mira: posted both; added note that we can accept fallback SKUs temporarily and requested confirmation of per-zone SKU mapping.

samir: small follow-up — if GCP only increases regional quota but not in specific zones, autoscaler might still fail if quota isn't available in the zone we pick. Suggest we set node pool auto-provisioning across at least two zones and add affinity to prefer europe-west4-b first. I'll update the k8s terraform snippet.

leah: re cost/reservation: finance wants a 7-day burn estimate + peak concurrency to evaluate a 1-week reserved commit (if supported) or preemptible mix. I'll send them the numbers.

mira: GCP replied again on the case: "Regional A100 quota increase is approved pending org confirmation. ETA: 24 hours for capacity activation. Secondary IPs increased. If you need faster turnaround, request escalation and provide business justification."

alex: ok plan: 1) Confirm org/billing details in case (done) 2) Set up fallback node pools with A2/T4 for non-prod 3) Configure autoscaler to prefer zone-b/c 4) Finance to evaluate short-term commit. Samir will update infra.

samir: will do. I'll also add a quick healthcheck that fails over to CPU-only fallbacks if GPU provisioning stalls.

leah: thanks all — keep this thread updated. If GCP says >48h we need to move to plan B (customer notification + temporary Dedicated pool).

alex: noted. please @mention if you hear any change. :thumbsup:
